verdict.rationale: Ollama documents a REST API with an API reference page (docs.ollama.com/api) and copy-paste curl, Python and JavaScript examples, so a basic reference with runnable snippets exists. Nothing shows an interactive try-it explorer, and the OpenAPI/Swagger probes all returned 404. Missing for 10: an interactive in-browser API explorer, a published OpenAPI spec, depth of the reference's example coverage, and independent corroboration.
